C0435.title: FraudBlocker Identifies and Blocks a Coordinated Carding Attack
C0435.summary: In an April 2026 article, FraudBlocker said its team deals with carding attacks regularly, sometimes seeing dozens of attempts every day for months. The article explains that attackers use stolen credit card details to make small test transactions on websites, automate large-scale card validation with bots, and can cause payment gateway blocks, processing fees, and chargeback losses.

references.title: How We Identified and Blocked a Coordinated Carding Attack
